text:
Tomas Hertl is playing about 15 minutes a night, down from his San Jose days, and getting more done with them than almost anyone on Vegas. He has 9 goals in 19 games, a four-game point streak with 4 goals in it, and two power-play goals in back-to-back wins over Pittsburgh and Buffalo.

The five-on-five numbers are the striking part. Vegas takes 63% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with Hertl on the ice, almost 13 points better than when he sits. His own chances are real too: 8.1 expected goals, among the higher rates on the team. He is shooting 18.8% against a range near 13%, so expect a few fewer goals, and Vegas has had some on-ice luck with him (5.3 goals above expected).

He also has 56 hits, which is a lot of contact for a 32-year-old with soft hands. Our projection is around 27 goals and 53 points. Fewer minutes, same Hertl, and maybe a better version of him.
headline: Hertl is driving Vegas from the third line
